modelAbilities.Acute Senses: Infiltrators always have to stay more than 18” away during deployment, even if there is no direct Line of Sight to this unit. The model is able to use the Acute Senses Meta-Order.
modelAbilities.Advisor: For each HQ selection, one copy of this unit may be taken without occupying an AOP slot.
modelAbilities.Aegis (X+): The model can dispel any psychic power directly targeting it on a roll of X+. It can also prevent a Perils of the Warp attack on a roll of X+. The best Aegis value from all models in the unit is used.
modelAbilities.Anti-Grav: The model ignores terrain, units, and vertical movement costs when moving.
modelAbilities.Berserk(X+): The model gains a X+ ward save, but it does not work against weapons with Strength 8 or higher. Limitations Cannot use the Escape command. Cannot use the Take Cover defensive reaction.
modelAbilities.Blank: Any model with this rule can never be targeted by any psychic power. Additionally, the model can't be targeted by anything outside of 18". Additionally, all psykers within 18" suffer a -1 penalty to manifest and deny psychic powers. Additionally, all units within 12" suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership values.
modelAbilities.Blind Rage: When not engaged in melee The unit moves 1D6" toward the nearest enemy unit instead of taking Leadership tests or receiving Battleshock tokens. This can result in the unit entering engagement range and starting melee combat as if using a Charge command. When engaged in melee If the unit fails a Leadership test, it loses 1D3 wounds instead of fleeing. Limitations Cannot use the Escape command. Cannot use the Take Cover defensive reaction.
modelAbilities.Bodyguard: Ranged Combat Wounds must first be assigned to the Bodyguard model before character models in the unit can be selected as targets. Close Combat Attacks must first target the Bodyguard model (if possible), before targeting characters. Bodyguards can pile in at the same time as character models in melee.
modelAbilities.Brotherhood of Psykers: If the unit has at least 2 models with this rule, it gains +1 to all psychic cast and deny rolls.
modelAbilities.Combat Squads: If the unit has the maximum number of models, it may be split into two smaller units of equal size during deployment.
modelAbilities.Command Squad: Models with this ability can join A squad. A single character. A squad that already has a character attached.
modelAbilities.Counter-Attack: The model is able to use the Counter-Attack Meta-Order.
modelAbilities.Deep Strike: Models arriving from reserve via Deep Strike can be placed anywhere on the battlefield. They are only allowed to receive the “Charge” or “Move & Shoot” order. Deployment Process: Place one model from the unit on the battlefield in the desired position. Roll a scatter die: If the result is a hit icon, the model remains in place. If the result is an arrow, move the model 2D6" in the indicated direction. Remaining models in the unit must be placed in a circle around the first model, touching it. If the first circle is full, begin a second circle, with each model touching one from the first circle. If the first model lands outside the playing field, on impassable terrain or another unit, the unit goes back into reserve and must take a dangerous terrain test. Models placed on terrain must take a dangerous terrain test, even if they normally ignore terrain. Placement Exceptions: If models cannot be placed due to space limitations, they count as destroyed. On terrain floors, models are only destroyed if there is no more available space. Empty spaces in the circle can be mentally skipped. The unit counts as having moved 6” and can’t move any further with its regular Movement profile. The unit may still make its “Charge move”. The unit may only perform a “Disorderly Charge”. Example The first model (1) is placed on the battlefield. A circle of models (2) is formed around the first. If there are any remaining models, another circle (3) is formed, and this process continues until all models are placed.
modelAbilities.Deflect: Ranged attacks against the model suffer a -1 penalty to hit rolls.
modelAbilities.Daemon: The model has a 5+ ward save.
modelAbilities.Daemonic Instability: The unit ignores the effects of a single Battleshock token. Upon gaining a second Battleshock token, the unit: Suffers 1D3+1 Mortal Wounds. Does not flee and can act normally. Close Combat Instead of fleeing after a lost combat, the unit suffers 1D3+2 Mortal Wounds and remains in place. Limitations The Mortal Wounds can’t be triggered more than once per Battle round for each unit. Cannot use the Escape command. Cannot use the Take Cover defensive reaction. Rally phase The unit automatically rallies during each Rally phase.
modelAbilities.Fast: Vehicles double their movement range (up to a maximum of 24"). The model may fire one additional weapon if it moves up to 12".
modelAbilities.Fearless: Automatically passes any Leadership test. Limitations Cannot use the Escape command. Cannot use the Take Cover defensive reaction.
modelAbilities.Favoured Enemy: At the start of the first battle round, select a faction (e.g., Space Marines). The model reduces its total penalty to hit rolls against the chosen faction from Armory equipment, datasheet abilities and psychic powers by 1, down to a minimum of 0. Additionally, Leadership tests caused by this model against the chosen faction have to be resolved with a cumulative penalty of -1.
modelAbilities.Frenzy(x”): The Infantry model gains x” increased movement for Charge movement.
modelAbilities.Furious Charge: The model gains +1 Strength and +1 Initiative until the end of the current battle round, when making a charge move.
modelAbilities.Greater Daemon: The model has a 4+ ward save.
modelAbilities.Haste(x”): The Infantry model gains x” increased movement for Advance movement.
modelAbilities.Hit & Run: After all models in a melee combat have been activated (but before the Combat Result is determined), the unit may move 3D6" away from the enemy in a straight line. The unit may not get into engagement range with another enemy unit with this move. The unit cannot consolidate after making this move. Enemy units cannot pursue and must make a 3” consolidation move if able.
modelAbilities.Hunter: The unit does not scatter when being set up via Deep Strike. Additionally, it gains Charge benefits normally and doesn't have to make a Disorderly Charge.
modelAbilities.Infiltrator: During deployment, a unit with this ability can be declared as an Infiltrator. After all normal deployment is complete, Infiltrators can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield, maintaining: 18" distance from enemy units if in direct line of sight. 12" distance if out of line of sight. Units deployed this way cannot make a Vanguard move. Simultaneous Units: If both players have Infiltrator units, alternate deploying them, starting with the player who deployed first.
modelAbilities.Massive(X): The model occupies X additional spaces in transport vehicles.
modelAbilities.Mindless: The unit automatically passes every Leadership test. It can contest mission objectives, but never hold them.
modelAbilities.Move Through Cover: The model does not suffer movement penalties for moving through terrain.
modelAbilities.Narthecium: Once per battle round, the damage of a wound against the model or attached unit can be reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Limitations: Can be declared after armor and ward saves. Does not work against weapons with Strength 8 or higher. Does not work against Mortal Wounds.
modelAbilities.Open: The vehicle has fire hatches equal to its passenger capacity. Passengers Can be targeted for ranged attacks. Count as physically present on the battlefield (e.g., Psykers can manifest powers). Measure ranges from the transport’s hull. Benefit from cover if the transport does. Cannot participate in melee combat while inside the vehicle. Can always make a 6” Charge move after disembarking, if the vehicle moved up to 12”. Benefit from the vehicle's ward save if it has one. Lose their order as normal but don’t make a compulsory move upon gaining two Battleshock tokens.
modelAbilities.Outflank: When arriving from reserves, the unit may also be deployed along the side edges of the battlefield. Limitations Units may not be deployed in the opponent's deployment zone. Units may not be deployed on the side edges on turn 1.
modelAbilities.Parry: Melee attacks against the model suffer a -1 penalty to hit rolls.
modelAbilities.Regeneration(X): The model regains X wounds at the start of each Reinforcement phase.
modelAbilities.Retribution(X): When the model is hit by a melee attack, it inflicts 1 automatic hit with Strength: U AP: 0 D: 1 against the attacking unit, to a maximum of x automatic hits per Battle round. If a unit contains multiple models with this rule, pool all instances of Retribution(x) together.
modelAbilities.Squadron: Each model in the selection becomes an independent unit during deployment and remains an independent unit for the rest of the game.
modelAbilities.Stealth: The model always counts as being in Heavy cover except when targeted by a Charge or Indirect weapons.
modelAbilities.Swarm: All attacks that target this unit have their Damage reduced to 1 if it was higher. Attacks (like "Blast(x)" or vehicle explosions) use the unit’s remaining Wounds (instead of the number of models) to determine the amount of hits they can generate.
modelAbilities.Tank Hunter: A single armor penetration roll against a vehicle or wound roll against a Monstrous creature can be re-rolled. If multiple models in a unit have the same weapon with this rule, the corresponding hit rolls can be made together. In this case, one roll per model may be re-rolled.
modelAbilities.Use Cover: Models benefiting from cover impose an additional -1 penalty to hit rolls for ranged attacks.
modelAbilities.Unique: The weapon or wargear may only be included once per army.
modelAbilities.Unyielding: Ranged Combat Shoot Heavy weapons with a Move & Shoot order. Can always fire Rapid Fire weapons up to full range. Fire all weapon types at a -1 hit penalty when executing a Charge order. Limitations Cannot receive the Advance order. Cannot pursue fleeing units in close combat.
modelAbilities.Vanguard: At the start of the first battle round, the unit can: Move 6" if deployed on the battlefield. Move 12" if deployed in a dedicated transport vehicle. Simultaneous Units: If both players have Vanguard units, alternate activating them, starting with the player who deployed first. The Vanguard movement is ignored when determining how far the unit has moved this turn.
modelAbilities.Ward(x+): The model gains a x+ ward save.
modelAbilities.Warded: The model gains a 6+ ward save, or improves an existing ward save by +1 (to a maximum of 4+). Cumulative with itself.
modelAbilities.Objective secured!: Effect If an objective is captured or controlled by a unit with this trait, the objective remains under the controlling player’s possession even if no friendly units remain in range. Control is only lost if the opposing player conquers or contests the objective with one of their own units at the end of a battle round. Transport Interaction Transport vehicles also benefit from this rule, if a unit embarked inside has it. Automatic Rule This special rule is automatically conferred to every Troop selection in the game. Units gain or lose this rule if they switch their battlefield role through Archetypes. Note: The Mission supplement goes into detail about controlling and scoring mission objectives.

weaponAbilities.Ammo(x): Wargear with this special rule can only be used x times per game. Can only be the target of a “Weapon Damage” result if at least one use is left.
weaponAbilities.Anti-Air: Attacks made with this weapon against models with the Anti-Grav, Jet Bike, or Jump Pack special rules or the Flyer unit type gain +1 to hit rolls and +1 Strength.
weaponAbilities.Armorbane(x): The weapon gains a +x bonus for armor penetration rolls.
weaponAbilities.AT(x): Can cause Penetrating Hits. On a Penetrating Hit, roll x amount of dice on the Vehicle Damage Chart and apply all results.
weaponAbilities.Beam: Choose a target and make a hit roll with the weapon as normal. If the hit is successful, draw a 1mm straight line from the nearest point of the shooting model’s base to the nearest point of a model in the target unit. Make a wound roll against the target unit and any other units the line passes over.
weaponAbilities.Blast(x): A successful hit roll with this weapon generates 1 hit per model in the target unit, to a maximum of x hits. An unsuccessful hit roll can be re-rolled once and can only generate half (rounded down) that many maximum hits.
weaponAbilities.Blind: If a weapon with this rule scores at least one hit, the target unit may only perform a Disorderly Charge.
weaponAbilities.Blood Drinker: For each Wound loss the model causes, it regains 1 Wound, up to the starting value in its profile. Example: A weapon with Damage 2 killing a unit with 1 Wound would restore 1 Wound.
weaponAbilities.Bomb: The range of this weapon is unaffected by the range increase rules for Flyers.
weaponAbilities.Charge: A weapon profile with this ability can only be used if the model is using a Charge command (even if making a Disorderly Charge).
weaponAbilities.Combi: Combination weapons, like the "Combi-melta," combine two profiles into one. A combi-weapon can fire both profiles simultaneously at the same target, with a -1 penalty to hit.
weaponAbilities.Deadly(x+): For each unmodified wound roll of x+ that successfully wounds the target, increase the Damage value of that attack by 1.
weaponAbilities.Decimate: Wound rolls gain a +1 bonus. Does not work against Vehicles.
weaponAbilities.Deflagrate(x+): Each successful unmodified hit roll of x+ scores one additional hit. Does not work with Blast(x) weapons.
weaponAbilities.Extra Attack(x): A ranged weapon can be used x amount of times with its profile during each activation, in addition to the model’s normal shooting attacks. A melee weapon makes x attacks with its profile during each activation, in addition to the model’s normal Attacks (A). A model may only benefit from extra attacks from one Armoury weapon.
weaponAbilities.Force Weapon: If the bearer successfully manifests at least one psychic power during their activation, any Force weapon they carry gains +1 Damage for the remainder of the battle round.
weaponAbilities.Grav: Unless it would already be better, the wound roll for this weapon is equal to the enemy unit’s armor save profile. Unless it is already worse, the armor save against this weapon is always 5+. Does not work against Vehicles.
weaponAbilities.Graviton: Creatures that lose a wound by this weapon must pass a Strength test or suffer another wound loss with S: 4 AP: 0 D: 1; Seeking. This is in addition to the actual wound roll. If the target enemy unit is in cover and at least one hit is scored with this weapon, the target counts as being in dangerous terrain until the end of the next activation of the target unit.
weaponAbilities.Gruesome: Every wound caused by a weapon with this rule counts as two for combat resolution. Models that are caught while fleeing from close combat suffer an additional automatic wound from this weapon.
weaponAbilities.Hover Mode: The model is eligible to use the “Stand & Shoot" order to land.
weaponAbilities.Haywire: Each hit causes one automatic penetrating hit against a Vehicle, in addition to any normal damage. Does not work against Creatures.
weaponAbilities.Life Curse: A single wound roll can be re-rolled against Creatures. If multiple models in a unit have the same weapon with this rule, they can make their wound rolls together. In this case, one wound roll per model may be re-rolled.
weaponAbilities.Limit(x): Only x attacks can be made with this weapon each turn.
weaponAbilities.Indirect: The weapon can target enemy units and cause casualties without LOS. Targets only gain a cover bonus if they are in a terrain zone. Weapons can only be fired indirectly using the “Stand & Shoot” command.
weaponAbilities.Master-crafted: A single hit roll can be re-rolled. If the weapon has the “Blast(x)”, or “Auto Hit” ability, a single wound or armor penetration roll can be re-rolled instead. If multiple models in a unit have the same weapon with this rule, the corresponding hit rolls can be made together. In this case, one hit roll per model may be re-rolled. Can't be used on “Grenade” type weapons with weapons with the “Ammo(x)” ability.
weaponAbilities.Melta: When targeting units within half the weapon's maximum range, the weapon gains +1 Damage, +2 AT and gains a +3 bonus for armor penetration.
weaponAbilities.Monofilament: If at least one hit has been scored with the weapon, the target counts as being in dangerous terrain until the end of the next activation of the target unit.
weaponAbilities.Overheating: Self-Inflicted Damage on Hit Rolls: Each roll of a 1 on a hit roll with this weapon causes the user to suffer a Mortal Wound. If the model is a vehicle, it instead suffers a glancing hit using the weapon's AT value. Re-Roll Restriction: If the model has any ability to re-roll hit rolls (such as from Blast(x), Psychic effects, or other rules), the result of the initial roll determines whether the weapon is overheating. Automatic Hits: For weapons that hit automatically, any roll of a 1 when determining wound rolls causes the user to suffer the same penalty: a Mortal Wound or, for vehicles, a glancing hit using the weapon's AT value. Wound Assignment: Wounds caused by Overheating must be allocated first to models equipped with Overheating weapons. These wounds cannot spill over to other models without Overheating weapons, overriding the standard rule that entire models must be removed first.
weaponAbilities.Piercing(x+): Unmodified wound rolls of x+ always succeed and improve the attack's AP by -2. Successful armor penetration rolls of x+ gain a +2 bonus to the result and are considered to have AT(1) unless their AT is already higher.
weaponAbilities.Poison(x+): Unmodified wound rolls of x+ against creatures always succeed. Can be affected by effects that give bonuses or penalties to wound rolls.
weaponAbilities.Precision(x+): Each successful unmodified hit roll of x+ automatically wounds creatures. Can’t be used with “Blast(x)” weapons.
weaponAbilities.Psi-shock: If a creature unit gets hit, a randomly chosen psyker model in that unit must pass a Leadership value test or suffer 1D3 Mortal Wounds. If a vehicle unit gets hit, a randomly chosen psyker model in that unit must pass a Leadership value test or suffer 1D3 instances of Critical Damage. Each additional hit from the same unit during the same activation incurs a cumulative -1 penalty for the test. Can’t be triggered more than once per activated unit.
weaponAbilities.Quick(+x): The model gains +x to its Initiative.
weaponAbilities.Rad: A unit hit by this weapon suffers a -1 penalty to its Toughness value until the end of its next activation.
weaponAbilities.Rending(x+): Each successful unmodified wound roll of x+ improves the attack's AP by -1.
weaponAbilities.Seeking: Enemy units in cover do not gain any cover benefit against this weapon and are treated as being outside of cover.
weaponAbilities.Shield Breaker(-x): Ward saves of enemy models are degraded by -x.
weaponAbilities.Shred: The model may re-roll any wound rolls made with this weapon. Does not work against Vehicles.
weaponAbilities.Slow(-x): The model suffers -x to its Initiative.
weaponAbilities.Sniper: The model gains +1 Ballistic Skill when using a weapon with this ability. The model may select a specific character model in the target unit for all to hit and to wound rolls. Use the target’s individual defensive profile for hitting and wounding it. Model’s with the Bodyguard ability must be targeted first, before a character model may be selected.
weaponAbilities.Soul Burn(x+): Each successful unmodified wound roll of x+ against Creatures inflicts 1 Mortal Wound in addition to normal weapon damage, even if the attack is saved. Does not work against Vehicles. Excess wounds don’t spill over to the next model, as the Mortal Wound is part of the original attack.
weaponAbilities.Sunder(x): Enemy units in cover reduce the benefit to their armor save from cover by -x (to a minimum of 0).
weaponAbilities.Suppression(x): Every hit from a weapon with this ability counts as x hits when determining Suppressive Fire
weaponAbilities.Unwieldy: The model does not gain an additional attack for having a pistol in close combat.
